paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Financial Analyst role on AWS Service FP&A. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I spent about five and a half years at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I follow cloud and data center infrastructure finance closely, and I like that this team owns the planning numbers for the services customers actually run on.

At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation, and built AI powered dashboards that automated reporting and saved hours each week. At Thomson Reuters I worked with finance teams on monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region.

That lines up with the planning cycles, the variance deep dives and the push to automate reporting. I'm comfortable with large data sets and with turning them into a clear story for leaders. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
